name: Assets
description: Centralized content store for all artifacts with rich rendering, search, task linking, manual upload, and clipboard paste

apiRoutes.summary: List unmanaged files awaiting explicit import
Import unmanaged files into versioned assets
Upload files as new versioned assets
Relink an asset to a task (or null)
Append a new version from an uploaded file

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_list
execTools.summary: List managed assets (one entry per asset, current-version view). Optional type and task filters.
execTools.description: List managed assets (one entry per asset, current-version view). Optional type and task filters.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_get
execTools.summary: Retrieve an asset manifest (versions, current pointer, exports) by assetId.
execTools.description: Retrieve an asset manifest (versions, current pointer, exports) by assetId.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_open
execTools.summary: Open an asset by assetId; returns its manifest plus extracted text for text-like assets.
execTools.description: Open an asset by assetId: returns its manifest plus the current version’s extracted text for text-like assets.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_save
execTools.summary: Save an agent-created file as a managed, versioned asset (upserts by source path).
execTools.description: Save an agent-created file as a managed, versioned asset. Re-saving the SAME source file appends a new version to the existing asset (or no-ops if unchanged) instead of creating a duplicate — so an evolving doc stays one asset with a version history. Returns the asset id.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_delete
execTools.summary: Soft-delete a whole asset (all versions) to trash.
execTools.description: Soft-delete a whole asset (all versions) to trash, restorable until trash is emptied.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_link
execTools.summary: Link an asset to a different task, or unlink it (set taskId to null).
execTools.description: Link an asset to a different task, or unlink it (set taskId to null).

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_list_trash
execTools.summary: List trashed assets (whole-asset deletions) with deletion time and version count.
execTools.description: List trashed assets (whole-asset deletions) with deletion time and version count.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_restore
execTools.summary: Restore a trashed asset by its trash name (from bakin_exec_assets_list_trash).
execTools.description: Restore a trashed asset by its trash name (from bakin_exec_assets_list_trash).

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_empty_trash
execTools.summary: Permanently delete all trashed assets. This cannot be undone.
execTools.description: Permanently delete all trashed assets. This cannot be undone.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_permanent_delete
execTools.summary: Permanently delete a specific trashed asset. This cannot be undone.
execTools.description: Permanently delete a specific trashed asset. This cannot be undone.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_audit
execTools.summary: Audit versioned-asset health: manifest integrity, current-pointer resolution, missing version files.
execTools.description: Audit versioned-asset health: manifest integrity, current-pointer resolution, and missing version files.

cliCommands.name: assets scan
cliCommands.summary: List unmanaged files awaiting explicit import

cliCommands.name: assets import
cliCommands.summary: Import unmanaged files into managed versioned assets
